record.question: 2025 plants are to be planted in a garden in such a way that each row contains as many plants as the number of rows, then the number of the plants in each row is
record.explanation: If there are n rows and n plants per row, n²=2,025. Since 45²=2,025, each row contains 45 plants, option D. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
